modules.name: VCO
modules.summary: Oscillator: sine, triangle, saw and square, pitch 0.1 per octave
modules.description:
- Oscillator, four waveforms at once (alias-suppressed), in [-1, 1]
- Pitch: 0.1 per octave, 0 = C4 (261.63 Hz); a pitch (a sequencer) dropped on it is added to it
- Octave and Tune transpose; FM: frequency modulation in octaves (an audio signal dropped on it)
- Width: the duty cycle of the square (pulse width modulation)

modules.name: SineVCO
modules.summary: Sine oscillator: a frequency in Hz and a gain; two of them make classic FM
modules.description:
- Sine oscillator: Freq in Hz, Gain from 0 to 1
- Freq is modulated linearly ([mod:lin]): f = Freq * (1 + D * m), D being the deviation set on the
modulation port (1 by default, from -10 to 10)
- Classic FM: the output of a SineVCO (the modulator, at fm) dropped on the Freq of another (the
carrier, at fc) gives the index I = D * Gain * fc / fm; with the same frequency, the Gain of the
modulator is the index. The frequency may go through zero (the phase then turns backwards).

modules.name: Noise
modules.description:
- Noise source: white noise, and pink (1/f) noise whose peaks stay near 1 (it sounds softer)
- Level: the level of both outputs

modules.name: VCF
modules.summary: Filter: low-pass, band-pass or high-pass, cutoff following a pitch
modules.description:
- State variable filter (12 dB per octave): low pass, band pass or high pass
- Cutoff in Hz; an envelope or an LFO dropped on it moves it in octaves
- Pitch: moves the cutoff, 0.1 per octave; a pitch dropped on it (a sequencer) makes the cutoff follow
the notes, its amount on the modulation port being the keyboard tracking
- Resonance: from no resonance to a sharp peak (Q from 0.5 to 25)

modules.name: VCA
modules.summary: Amplifier: gain driven by an envelope, linear or exponential
modules.description:
- Amplifier: the audio input times the gain, in [0, 1]
- Gain 0 (default): closed until an envelope dropped on it opens it (depth 1: the envelope is the gain)
- Response: linear, or exponential (60 dB from 0 to 1, a natural loudness curve)

modules.name: ADSR
modules.summary: Envelope: attack, decay, sustain, release, from a gate
modules.description:
- Envelope generator in [0, 1], started by the Gate and released when it falls
- Gate: a button to play by hand; a gate dropped on it (a sequencer, a clock) drives it
(high above 0.6, low below 0.4)
- Attack, Decay and Release in seconds; Sustain is a level
- To shape a level: drop the envelope on the Gain of a VCA

modules.name: LFO
modules.summary: Low frequency oscillator, four shapes, bipolar or unipolar, with reset
modules.description:
- Low frequency oscillator: sine, triangle, saw or square
- Polarity: bipolar in [-1, 1], or unipolar in [0, 1]
- Reset: restarts the cycle; a clock dropped on it syncs the LFO

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description:
- Mixes four signals (audio or CV): the sum of each input times its level
- At level 1 a signal goes through unchanged

modules.name: Offset
modules.summary: Attenuverter and offset; transposes a pitch in semitones
modules.description:
- Attenuverter, offset and precision adder: out = in * Gain + Offset + Transpose
- Gain from -1 (inverted) to 1; Offset from -1 to 1
- Transpose in semitones, for a pitch (0.1 per octave): 12 semitones add 0.1

modules.name: Clock
modules.summary: Clock: gates at a tempo, quarter, eighth or sixteenth notes, with reset
modules.description:
- Clock: gates (0 or 1) at Tempo beats per minute
- Division: a gate per quarter, eighth or sixteenth note
- Width: how long each gate stays high, as a fraction of its period
- Reset: restarts the clock (a gate starts at once); a gate dropped on it drives it

modules.name: Sequencer
modules.summary: Sequencer: eight steps of pitch and gate, driven by a clock
modules.description:
- Step sequencer: each rising edge of the Clock moves to the next of the Length steps
- Clock: a button to step by hand; a clock dropped on it drives the sequencer
- Each step is a pitch in semitones above C4 (0.1 per octave on the pitch output); -1 is a rest
- Gate: high while the clock is high, except on rests; the pitch holds during a rest
- Reset: goes back before the first step (the next clock plays it)

modules.name: Quantizer
modules.summary: Quantizer: a pitch to the nearest note of a scale
modules.description:
- Moves a pitch (0.1 per octave) to the nearest note of a scale, ties going down
- Scale: chromatic, major, natural minor, major or minor pentatonic
- Tonic: the first note of the scale

modules.name: SampleHold
modules.summary: Sample and hold of an input or of noise, at each trigger
modules.description:
- Samples a signal at each rising edge of the Trigger and holds it until the next one
- Trigger: a button to sample by hand; a clock dropped on it drives it
- Source: the input, or internal noise (random values in [-1, 1], with a clock: stepped random)

modules.name: Level
modules.summary: Level meter, inserted anywhere: the signal goes through unchanged
modules.description:
- Level meter, inserted anywhere: the signal goes through unchanged
- RMS: mean level over 50 ms, in dB
- Peak: peak level, held and released over 0.5 s, in dB

modules.name: StereoLevel
modules.summary: Level meter of two channels, inserted anywhere: the signals go through unchanged
modules.description:
- Level meter of two channels, inserted anywhere: the signals go through unchanged
- RMS level over 50 ms of each channel, in dB

modules.name: Value
modules.summary: Shows the value of a signal (a modulation source, a control signal), inserted anywhere: the signal
modules.description:
- Shows the value of a signal (a modulation source, a control signal), inserted anywhere: the signal
goes through unchanged
- The bar covers [-1, 1]; the number is the value itself

modules.name: Scope
modules.summary: Oscilloscope and spectrum analyser, inserted anywhere: the signal goes through unchanged
modules.description:
- Oscilloscope and spectrum analyser, inserted anywhere: the signal goes through unchanged
- View: the waveform, or the spectrum
- Waveform: Time is the duration shown (1 ms to 5 s, in [-1, 1]); short durations are triggered on a
crossing of the Threshold (Slope: rising or falling; Trigger auto: the signal is shown even without a
crossing, normal: the last image stays), long ones scroll (modulation sources, envelopes)
- Spectrum: in dB of a sine (0 dB: a sine at full scale), on a logarithmic axis with a line per
semitone (Scale: log) or a linear one; the strongest peak is written (frequency, note, level)
- The corner at the bottom right resizes the display
